name: choops-extractor
description: A native desktop and command-line research suite for College Hoops 2K8 PS3 textures, archives, CDF/IFF pairs, rosters, and modding workflows

scripts.pack:cli: pkg -t node18-win-x64 -o release/choops-extractor.exe --compress GZip index.js && node scripts/copy-native-tools.js
scripts.pack:native: npm run pack:cli && npm run check:dotnet && dotnet publish native-desktop/ChoopsModdingSuite/ChoopsModdingSuite.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:PublishReadyToRun=true -o release && npm run pack:gui
scripts.desktop: npm run pack:cli && npm run check:dotnet && dotnet run --project native-desktop/ChoopsModdingSuite/ChoopsModdingSuite.csproj
